messages:
Sara C (CS): Quick weekly check-in for ClearNova — attaching the p95/p99 split by route/model and stream vs sync. TL;DR: streaming reduces tail for most models, but we have a regression on redwood-v2-large sync causing spikes and UI jitter.

Mike L (SRE): Pulled the telemetry dump. Short summary:
- /chat.generate (redwood-v2-large): streaming p95 210ms, p99 540ms; sync p95 190ms, p99 860ms.
- /summarize (redwood-compact-1): streaming p95 120ms, p99 320ms; sync p95 140ms, p99 410ms.
- /embed (embed-mini): streaming N/A, sync p95 45ms, p99 120ms (batching dominates).
- Cost note: ClearNova spend +12% MoM; ~9% requests fell back to sync which increased token cost due to lower batching efficiency.

Anya P (Product): Interesting — streaming p95 sometimes higher but p99 much better vs sync. Could be due to KV warm-hit variance + per-token overhead.

Liam G (Eng): Confirming — sync has higher variance when long-sequence requests hit and cause KV cache misses and model regeneration. Streaming amortizes regen across chunks but adds per-token overhead, so median moves up in some buckets while tail tightens.

Mike L (SRE): Logs show a cluster of 502/504s tied to autoscaler thrash yesterday at ~2026-03-18T14:03Z. Example entry:
`[2026-03-18T14:03:07Z] route=/chat.generate model=redwood-v2-large status=502 latency_ms=874 pool=clearnova-dedicated node=n3-12`

Sara C (CS): Customer reported 3 end-user complaints this week about UI lag. Current renewal risk: LOW but moving to MONITORING if tail persists. Need quick wins for next call.

Anya P (Product): Proposed recommendations for ClearNova:
1) Default to streaming for /chat.generate and expose client toggle so power users can opt out.
2) Increase autoscaler tolerance for redwood-v2-large (reduce scale-down frequency).
3) Enable prefix KV caching for their main prompt templates (saves regen).
4) Small prompt refactor to reduce max tokens on common flows.

Liam G (Eng): I'll open ops ticket CN-421 to adjust autoscaler and enable prefix cache on the ClearNova pool. ETA: EOD tomorrow for staging change, rollout after smoke tests.

Mike L (SRE): I'll re-run telemetry slicing by seq-length buckets and stream vs sync per-model. Will add heatmaps and attach to the ticket.

deploy-bot: Deploy started: autoscaler-config update for customer=clearnova by Liam G at 2026-03-19T09:10Z :rocket:

Sara C (CS): Scheduling an enablement call with ClearNova for Friday 10am PT to demo streaming tradeoffs and new defaults. Who can join?

Anya P (Product): I'll attend and capture product-level feedback + decision notes.

Mike L (SRE): I'll join for the ops/runbook portion and to walk through telemetry.

Sara C (CS): Action items recap:
- Liam: change autoscaler + enable prefix cache (ticket #CN-421)
- Mike: produce detailed telemetry + heatmaps
- Anya/Sara: run Friday enablement call and capture feedback
- Sara: update renewal risk to MONITORING and log complaints

Sara C (CS): Pinging @clearnova-success to confirm Friday 10am PT.
